role: Two value types describing a strap: one seen in a BLE scan and one previously paired (persisted via StrapPairingStore).
types: StrapDiscoveredDevice: struct — scan result (id, name, rssi, deviceType); aliased as PolarManager.DiscoveredDevice
StrapKnownDevice: struct (Codable) — paired strap (id, name, deviceType); aliased as PolarManager.KnownDevice, JSON-encoded into ud:PolarManager.knownDevices
toplevel: Declarations only; Codable synthesis for StrapKnownDevice is used by StrapPairingStore.save/decode (JSON keys id,name,deviceType).
